text:
"Five minutes from Shinjuku Station." With a suitcase, from your actual train, it can be closer to twenty. 🧳

We traced one real hotel that says this: Hotel Gracery Shinjuku in Kabukicho, "5 minutes from JR Shinjuku's East Exit".

━━━━━━━━━━
🚆 1. FROM THE NARITA EXPRESS
━━━━━━━━━━

• Our sample N'EX: Narita 15:14, Shinjuku 16:41, ¥3,330
• It stops at platforms 5–6
• JR East says the lift route from there leads to the New South, Koshu-kaido and Miraina Tower gates: the south end
• The hotel is at the north end, about 970 m away on the street
• With bags, we budget 15–20 minutes to reception (on the 8th floor)

━━━━━━━━━━
🚇 2. FROM THE ADVERTISED EXIT
━━━━━━━━━━

• From the JR East Exit plaza it really is about 470 m, around 6 minutes
• Step-free option: Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line lifts from the East Gate to Exit B11 or A6
• Those lifts run 6:00–23:00 only
• Exit B11 to the hotel: about 450 m

━━━━━━━━━━
🚌 3. FROM THE AIRPORT BUS
━━━━━━━━━━

• Narita Limousine Bus straight to Tokyu Kabukicho Tower, ¥3,600
• 115 minutes on our sample timetable, about 30 minutes slower than N'EX
• But the stop is only about 200 m from the hotel door

━━━━━━━━━━
✅ OUR TAKE
━━━━━━━━━━

Always check which exit the "minutes" are counted from. For a Kabukicho hotel with a big suitcase, take the bus when one leaves within about 30 minutes of clearing customs; otherwise take N'EX and allow 15–20 minutes. If your hotel is near the South Exit or Busta Shinjuku, the N'EX lift route ends right there and the train wins.

Full trace with every distance 👉 https://japanbystation.com/shinjuku-five-minutes-with-a-suitcase

Has a "5 minutes from the station" hotel ever surprised you? 👇
